== Summary ==
Original slip, 30 May 2003: Take Evasive Action (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 30 May 2003 sheet for [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf Virtual Set #5 first release sheet] (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; PDF on theforce.net, Internet Archive capture 1 August 2003), page 3, slip 48. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Take Evasive Action (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)]].

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/1d/OVS5-48-Take_Evasive_Action-original-slip-2003-05-30.png Internet Archive item].
